author: Chris
text:
I’ve used Sennheiser headphones for years and after buying my wife a pair of Accenture wireless headphones I decided to try out the Momentum 4s.

The audio quality from these headphones are incredible, out of the box they’re extremely clear with great bass response - some people might not like the default eq settings because it leans into the treble side quite a lot, but the customisable EQ in the app makes it easy to change this if you want.

The noise cancelling is great, it works amazing with consistent low level background noise (think walking along a busy street) but can struggle to keep up with sudden loud or jarring noises (people dropping weights in a gym). You can’t really notice that too much with music playing though so I wouldn’t let it put me off.

The battery life is absolutely brilliant, I’ve had these a little over a month with almost daily use and only had to charge them once! 

Overall If you’re looking for a pair of overhead wireless headphones but don’t want to spend stupid amounts of money, I couldn’t recommend these enough
